name: What types of ADUs can I build on my property?

mainEntity.name: What types of ADUs can I build on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically build several types of ADUs: detached (a standalone structure), attached (an addition to the main house), garage conversion (transforming an existing garage), and junior ADUs (JADUs, which are smaller units within the existing footprint of a single-family home). The feasibility of each type depends on your property's size, local zoning regulations, and existing structures. An ADU contractor can assess your site and recommend the best option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common ADU types include detached, attached, garage conversion, and junior ADUs. Feasibility depends on property and local regulations.
